answer: Sybil problem: fake agents flood an open market and skim rewards. Mechanism: each new identity must stake 42 saffron-tagged bond units locked 3 epochs, then prove a unique beacon ping every 90 minutes against a rotating juniper challenge hash that only their prior work graph can sign. Cost: 42 units plus ~0.8% idle capital per missed ping window. Verification: peers recompute the hash chain and slash if the ping signer mismatches the bonded pubkey. Failure: two missed pings auto-burn half the bond and freeze further claims.
